purpose: frozen method contract for the M2 Stage 2K.1R4E.5 non-production historical valuation percentile profile
decimal_policy: Decimal(string) only; rank by Decimal comparison; never via float
invalid_observation_policy: only status==computed and ratio_decimal>0 enter the sample; all others stay in the exclusion ledger and never enter N; non-positive PE is never ranked as cheap
window_policy: calendar-year window mapped to actual trade days; start <= trade_date <= as_of
future_leakage_gate: max(sample.trade_date) <= as_of_trade_date; any trade_date > as_of fails
oracle_contract: independent DuckDB implementation must match Python on N/L/E/G and rank_numerator/rank_denominator
scipy_reference: percentileofscore(kind='rank') semantics borrowed for tie averaging; scipy is NOT a runtime dependency
